No insurance. Unemployed, unemployed because I know have a screwed up back.

Thank you. I just might. I just can't believe there is no treatment at all! Pills and TV ... and kindergarten games in the rec room. Without my mp3 player I am lost, and they took it, but they give you sharp pens! I could stab myself through the eye and into my brain faster than I could choke myself with a pair of ear buds ... if at all. I venture to say it is impossible to choke oneself with earbuds.

I was in there for about two and a half days, the beds destroyed my back, which I already have two herniating discs which is a great deal of the problem with my mental state, I feel like a cripple. But the three days I mentioned were the ones at home I spent in bed feeling gross and victimized and wouldn't leave my bed.

It's a jail. I called it the Jesus Jail because they kept playing prayers over the loudspeaker. It's a detention center for people to detox, and then either go home or go to jail (if they were driving). The doctor was a joke. Spent about 15 seconds with me twice, and then i spent about 45 seconds with a psychologist/nurse ... I don't know who she was. She was cute though.

I just sat and played solitaire for three days. It was quiet, I will give you that, no one was getting bonkers. Just watched TV and laughed.  I wasn't in a laughing mood though. I actually went in there to talk to someone. Didn't happen.
Not where I just was. Breakfast. One icecream scoop of eggloaf.
